verdict.rationale: PostHog runs a free hosted MCP server at mcp.posthog.com that works with Claude, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients and lets agents run trends, funnels, retention and SQL/HogQL queries, with tools like execute-sql and governed semantic-layer metrics such as MRR (beta). For direct API access, a documented POST /query endpoint accepts HogQL using a scoped key, and the CLI can run SQL headlessly. A probe confirms the MCP endpoint is live and OAuth-gated with granular scopes. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually answering growth questions through MCP or API queries (the probe only confirms the endpoint is reachable and auth-gated).
